name: icad-agentic-cad
description: Engineering-brief-first prompt preparation, blueprint reasoning, visual feedback, native agentic CAD design, standards-aware assembly, validation, animation, and manufacturing export with ICAD.

interface.shortDescription: Design and validate programmable native 3D models.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through a traceable engineering preparation record before ICAD generation, followed by direct visual feedback and validated geometry, mechanisms, standards-aware manufacturing connections, materials, scenes, drawings, and artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an engineering brief, conceptualize once, and create a professional ICAD model with visual feedback.
Inspect this ICAD design and fix compiler diagnostics.
Build an animated ICAD assembly and verify every export.
